name: split-canvas
title: Split Canvas
description: Scroll-synced canvas transition that reveals images through sliced pixel-grid shutters

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: the pixel-grid shutter transition becomes a plain crossfade between images

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Pixel-dissolve shader's grid cell size, in px.

props.name: numSlices
props.description: Number of horizontal slices the pixel-wipe transition is split into.

props.name: canvasSize
props.description: Size (px) of the central transitioning canvas panel on desktop - mobile/tablet sizes scale proportionally.
